title: Tech Note: Managing Server Files from the Client
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: GET DOCUMENT PROPERTIES / GET DOCUMENT ICON

historical_commentary.text: The client/server file-browsing pattern here — using Execute on server methods plus FOLDER LIST/DOCUMENT LIST to expose a sandboxed server directory to remote 4D clients — remains fully valid in current 4D for classic client/server deployments, since all referenced commands are still supported. It's less commonly needed today given that many deployments have shifted toward web/REST-based architectures where file management is handled differently (e.g. through REST endpoints or cloud storage), but for traditional 4D client/server apps this is still a directly usable pattern.
related_updates: FOLDER LIST, DOCUMENT LIST, GET DOCUMENT PROPERTIES/ICON remain current 4D commands
Execute on server remains the standard mechanism for client/server method dispatch
Web/REST-based deployments now offer alternative file-management approaches outside classic client/server
